d: India’s Got Latent Season 2 sparks major controversy after comedian Samay Raina made a controversial remark during a conversation with contestant Salma Diwani, a Hyderabadi character performed by theatre artist Bhagyashree Tarke. After her impressive performance that earned a perfect 10 and cash prize, Samay asked if anyone from Mumbai had accompanied her. When she mentioned a cousin living in Mumbai, Samay quipped that it must be her husband. Panelist and Bollywood actress Huma Qureshi reacted strongly to the comment, with reports claiming she was so upset she nearly walked off the set…
